ruleDefinitions.name: Copying Sensitive Files with Credential Data
ruleDefinitions.description: Files with well-known filenames (sensitive files with credential data) copying

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "\\esentutl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*vss.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/m\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/y\\ .*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\RegBack\\\\sam.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\RegBack\\\\security.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\RegBack\\\\system.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\sam.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\security.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\system\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\repair\\\\sam.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\repair\\\\security.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\repair\\\\system.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\windows\\\\ntds\\\\ntds\\\.dit.*"))
